limitations: Static and Python only: nothing of the project ran. Review each capability's entries.
Settings, registered names, file formats and messages users rely on are not found by reading names: add them to the capability's interface in plain words.
A capability left without a check gets behavior tests from the test design when a job freezes.

A check listed under checks_not_inspected, and a kept check that reaches internal names through an object a fixture hands it or through a helper outside the test files, still holds the rewrite to those names: review them. Private names are looked for in a check's own test files, the conftest.py above them and the test modules they import, by file: a check is left out whole for one test that certainly uses a private name.
A name stated for a kept check (checks_kept_with_names_stated) tells the author to keep the name, not what the check does with it: review those entries.

Python files that are data and nothing else (literals assigned to names: no import, function, class or call) and at least 90% literal data are in the manifest's carry list (carried) unless --no-carry was given: the verifier puts them into every candidate unchanged, no author writes them and they count on neither side of the size comparison. A data table below that share, or with code beside its data, is only listed (carry_candidates, with its share under carry_candidate_shares): carry it when its data is a table users rely on, knowing that its code is then carried as it stands too and that no author sees or replaces it.
